A light cardigan transformed by a textural crochet stitch. Layer it over tanks
or tees, in airy organic linen.

Style No. S4KMR-K5414

Design


- A generous, boxy fit that drapes away from the body to create movement.

- Madison is 5'9" and wears a size S, which measures 35 1/2 inches on the body.
Size 1X measures 37 inches on the body.

- High collar, cap sleeves, 7-inch side slits.

- Style No. S4KMR-K5414
- SKU:

Fabric


- Organic linen in a textural knit that's cool to the touch, light and breathable.
With the uneven, nuanced color that comes from délavé dyeing. A subtle effect,
unique to each garment.

- May snag on jewelry. Wear with care.

- Made in China. 100% Organic Linen.


Sustainability


- Organic farming supports clean water and healthy soil.
